Now, on every data structure, we perform some basic operations.

how to input elements in the array, how to give items to your plot, to your house,

So, we will talk about all these operations. Let's start with the creation of an array.
Now, there is a syntax to create an array, in which we first write the data type.
This data type can be either int, string, float, character, or double.
That is, we can write any possible data type here.
Then we will write the name of our array.
Now, the name of this array can be any value.
We have created this, it is a variable name that is made by the user.
After that, we will put square brackets.
There will be some keys on your keyboard like this.
We call them square brackets. It is not necessary to give space in between.
If you add space here, there will be no problem.
So, after putting square brackets, we tell the memory on the right side that we are going to create an array.
If we write only this part, then the array will not be created.
Here, we have declared the array that we have to create an array.
Here, we have actually created an array.
With the help of this new keyword.
What does the new keyword do?
It gives us a location in the memory of our computer.
That is, it gives us a plot, after which we can make our data structure there.
So, new, then the name of the data type, what type of structure do we need, and then size in square brackets.
That is, how many sizes of location do we need for our array?
If we have to store 5 numbers in the array, then we need 5 integers of location.
If we have to store 10 numbers, then we need 10 integers of location.
If we have to store 100,000 numbers, then we have to write 100,000 in our size.
So, let's see the code syntax or code examples.
First of all, let's talk about int.
Here, we have made an array of integer size.
In this, we have written marks.
After that, we have put square brackets.
Then on the right side, we have written new keyword and after that integer and then size.
So, the size of the integer we are trying to create here is equal to 50 integers.
Let's write this in our code.
We have made a class here.
We have given the name of this class as ArrayCC because we are writing code for the classroom.
Now, we have made the main function in this.
Let's define an array in the main function.
We will write int, after that the name of our array is marks.
We will put square brackets, then equal to new int of size 50 and finally we will put statement terminator.
So, in this way, an array of 50 sizes will be created.
Now, one more special thing about arrays is that the type of arrays is static.
That means, if you have given the size of marks equal to 50, then you will not be able to store 51 marks.
You will not be able to store 60 marks.
Once the size of the array is declared, then you cannot change the size while the code is running.
If you want to change, then we can cut it to 49 now.
When this program will be executed, then there will be no change in the size of the array at the run time.
Now, there is a slightly different syntax to define the array.
In this, we write the type of the array, then its name, then square brackets.
And what we will do on the right side, we will write all the elements of the array.
That means, if we have to make an array of three sizes and we know the values of all three, then write all three on the right side.
Then we will not have to tell the size.
Java will automatically detect that you have written only these elements, that means you need an array of this size.
So, if we want to declare the size of the array, then we will make int numbers is equal to 1, 2, 3.
So, what did Java do?
It has automatically given the size of the array named numbers equal to 3.
Now, you can define more arrays in a similar way.
We made an array named more numbers and added 4, 5, 6 to it.
Now, let's talk about making another type of array.
For example, if we want to make an array of string type, then we will write the type of it, then name, then square brackets.
After that, we will store our strings one after another.
And what will be the size of this array?
The size of this array will be 3 because it has 3 strings stored.
The size of this array will also be 3 because it has 3 numbers stored.
And the size of this array will also be 3 because it has 3 numbers stored.
Now, we have not stored any number in this array.
So, it is empty from inside.
By default, when we do not tell anything in the array, then it is stored as 0.
If we make it of string type, then only the string will be stored.
If we make it of character type, then only the character will be stored.
That is, until you store any element in the array, it will take null values.
So, until we store the original marks on all these locations, it will be 0.
